entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I need to inquire about a return for a VeloBand Pulse HR monitor I recently purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for one VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 15th. That was 23 days ago. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's not a technical fault, the device seems to work fine. The problem is the timing. We had a sudden family emergency right after it was delivered.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you elaborate?

My husband is in the military and was scheduled for deployment, but he had to have an unexpected, emergency surgery. I've been at the hospital with him for the past three weeks. I just got home and realized I'm past what I thought the return period was. I know policy is policy, but given the circumstances, I was hoping we could negotiate something, maybe a partial credit?
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear about your husband's surgery. I certainly hope he's recovering well. Let me just double-check the return policy for you. Please hold for one moment.
Okay, thank you.
Alright, thank you for waiting. I've reviewed your order and our policy, and I have good news. You're actually well within the return window.
Really? I thought it was a very short window for wearable tech. I read something like 10 or 20 days.
Not at all. The VeloFit return policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the date of delivery. So, you have plenty of time. We can definitely process a full refund for you.
Wow, 90 days. That's fantastic. I completely misunderstood. Yes, please, let's proceed with the return.

Absolutely. I've just initiated that for you. You will receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just package the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You've made this incredibly easy, David. Thank you so much.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help and your well wishes.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
